questiontext.text: Which of the following are examples of INFORMAL social control? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Parental corrections, community praise, neighbor disapproval, and peer boundaries are informal controls. Court sentencing is formal control.

questiontext.text: Which of the following are severe consequences of institutional decay and systemic corruption? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Crime, decayed infrastructure, youth brain drain, and loss of trust reflect institutional failure. Thriving infrastructure reflects strong institutions.
